Favor selective exposure to domestic digital economy leaders benefiting from rising middle-class consumption and regulatory tailwinds, while avoiding US-linked names.

sectors.ai: Indonesia's renewables sector shows resilient outperformance vs US peers, driven by domestic policy tailwinds and strong project pipelines. Maintain overweight on Indonesian climate-tech, as structural demand from industrial electrification and government mandates outweighs global rate headwinds.

Key movers like AGAR and ZATA signal robust local consumption, making selective exposure to staples and discretionary names attractive for near-term alpha.

Maintain WATCH for a catalyst-driven entry, given the divergence between broad index and high-beta movers.
